info.name: PowerMesh Server
info.description: Postman collection for the PowerMesh Server. All implemented routes under /api/v1/auth, /api/v1/provider, /api/v1/offer, /api/v1/event, /api/v1/request, /api/v1/reservation, /api/v1/payments, /api/v1/users, /api/v1/delivery, and /api/v1/admin.

Requires CONSUMER role. Creates the payment record (gatewayStatus: PROCESSING), persists the bKash create response, and returns data.bkashURL + data.paymentID. Reservation must be ALLOCATED or PAYMENT_PENDING. Open data.bkashURL in your browser and complete the sandbox payment.

bKash redirect callback (no auth). Executes the payment with bKash, then redirects the browser to the frontend: FRONTEND_URL/my-payments?status=success|failure|cancel. On success the payment is marked COMPLETED and the reservation becomes PAYMENT_COMPLETED; on failure/cancel the reservation is released back to ALLOCATED. Only paymentID + status are required; merchantInvoiceNumber is optional.

Requires ADMIN or OPERATOR role. Computes and returns the allocation plan for an event (no changes persisted). Event must be SCHEDULED or CONFIRMED.
Requires ADMIN or OPERATOR role. Recomputes the plan and persists reservations, marking requests ALLOCATED, updating offer utilization, incrementing event.allocatedKw, and writing an audit log.

Requires ADMIN or OPERATOR role. FAILED/REFUNDED create a refund + incident, call the bKash refund gateway (storing gatewayRefundId + gateway response), and release offer capacity; DELIVERY_CONFIRMED resolves pending/disputed deliveries.
